observation.description: A membership-backed table cannot participate in the versioned seed at all: naming orgMembers with an EMPTY row array refuses at install with SNAPBACK_SEED_MEMBERSHIP_BOOTSTRAP_UNSUPPORTED ('sessions-mode versioned seed cannot install membership rows'). Because unnamed tables are not reset targets, a versioned reset-install restores every data table to the literal fixture while every membership seat SURVIVES the reset — the fixture reset cannot retire authority, and a fixture cannot establish it. The arm's cleanup had to choreograph per-persona self-removal (leaveOrg × 3) before the receipted reset, and post-reset verification had to re-redeem a restored invite to earn a seat back.

competitorOutcome.description: Frozen Convex Linear-arm evidence seeds memberships as ordinary rows in the same fixture as app data, so a fixture reset restores both data and authority in one deterministic operation.

mustNotRegress: Membership rows never enter through raw writes; the private-roster posture and the transition matrix stay the only authority-creating paths at the app surface.
smallestCoherentFix: A declaration-checked trusted-import lane for the versioned seed: seed rows for a membership table are admitted only when they satisfy the declared roles (an explicitly marked fixture context, mirroring the 'trusted migration/import context' the scoped-roles design already reserves), and named membership tables become reset targets so a reset-install retires runtime seats.
acceptanceWitness: A seed naming a membership table with fixture seats installs on a fresh sessions database; a reset-install deletes runtime seats and restores exactly the fixture seats; a principal holding a runtime-only seat is denied after the reset.
